data.title: How to Use the Grasen App for EV Charging and Payment
data.description: Learn how to use the Grasen App to find nearby chargers, check charging status and prices, start a session, make payments and review your charging records.
data.content:
Using a Grasen charging station for the first time?

Quick answer: Open the Grasen App → find an available charger → scan the QR code or select the charger → start charging → monitor the session → recharge your account or complete payment using the available payment options → check your charging and payment records.

Here is the full process.


Step 1: Download and Log In

Search “GRASEN” in Google Play or the App Store and install the app.

When you open it:

1. Select the charging operator.

2. Enter your mobile number or email.

3. Enter the verification code.

4. Log in.

The app also supports multiple languages for users in different markets.



Step 2: Find a Charging Station

Open the map after logging in.

You can search for nearby chargers and filter them by:

· connector type;

· availability;

· charging power.

This lets you check whether a suitable charging point is available before you arrive.



Step 3: Check Status, Power and Price

Tap a charging station to view its details.

The app can show:

· station name;

· distance;

· charging-point status;

· rated charging power;

· electricity price;

· service fee.



Step 4: Start Charging

There are two ways to begin a charging session.


Option 1: Scan the QR Code

Tap the scan icon in the app and scan the QR code on the charger.


Option 2: Select the Charger in the App

Open the station details, choose an available charging point and tap Start Charging.

The app may then ask you to select your expected charging time. Confirm the settings to start the session.



Step 5: Check Charging Status

While the vehicle is charging, the app displays real-time information including:

· voltage;

· current;

· charging power;

· SOC;

· energy delivered

· charging cost

You can also stop the charging session from the app when needed.




Step 6: How to Recharge and Pay

How do I add money to my account?

Open your account page and follow these steps:

1. Tap Recharge.

2. Choose the recharge amount.

3. Select an available payment method.

4. Complete the payment.

Available payment methods may include PayPal and credit card and may vary by charging operator and market. Follow the payment options shown in your app.

After a recharge is completed, you can check the transaction under Payment History.



(Payment methods and currency shown in the app may vary by charging operator and market.)

Account → Recharge → Amount → Payment Method


Step 7: Check Your Charging and Payment Records

After charging, open your account page to review previous activity.

Charging History

You can check:

· charging station;

· energy delivered;

· charging cost;

· start time;

· end time.

Payment History

You can review previous recharge and payment transactions.



Extra Features

RFID Card

The app supports RFID card binding, and multiple cards can be added to one account.



Charger Reservation

Where supported, users can select a charging point, choose an available time slot and reserve it in advance.



Need Help?

If you have trouble using the app, open Contact Us to find the support information provided by the charging operator.
